reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"const repo = 'acme/cli'; const label = 'needs-triage'; const candidates: number[] = []; let page: number | null = 1; while (page !== null) { const result = await tools.list_issues({repo, state: 'open', page}); for (const issue of result.items) { if (issue.state === 'open' && issue.labels.length === 0) candidates.push(issue.number); } page = result.next_page; } const failures: {number: number; error: string}[] = []; let updated = 0; for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i += 10) { await Promise.all(candidates.slice(i, i + 10).map(async number => { try { const issue = await tools.get_issue({repo, number}); if (issue.state !== 'open' || issue.labels.length !== 0) return; const result = await tools.add_label({repo, number, label}); if (!result.labels.some(item => item.name === label)) throw new Error('Label missing from update result'); updated++; } catch (error) { failures.push({number, error: String(error)}); } })); } return {candidates: candidates.length, updated, failures};","answer":""}
